summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Forty-First Supplemental Indenture dated September 11, 2026, under its 2009 senior indenture, establishing a series of €750,000,000 6.061% fixed-rate floating-rate senior unsecured notes due 2035. The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch acts as trustee; HSBC Bank USA is paying agent, registrar and calculation agent; Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton supplied US and English opinions. Terms include make-whole and loss-absorption disqualification event redemption plus UK bail-in acknowledgment. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
